title: Bruce Leuchter:
title_short: Bruce Leuchter · To Every GRIN Parent
length: about 62 s (the five brief bites run 57 s)
headline: One message from the drug company CEO straight to GRIN parents: we learned from you, and you are at the center of the work every day.
story: Bruce speaks to every parent in the GRIN community: we care deeply about your lived experiences.
Family meetings move him every time. The mission is bigger than one medicine; it is about how families will live their lives. They run a company, but they serve patients and families.
He ends where he began: you are front and center for what we do every day.

Hook text TO EVERY GRIN PARENT on frame 1, static.
Close on D1's second half, from “We've learned a lot from you as a community”.
If D1 doesn't join cleanly in two halves, use the whole D1 take as hook plus button.
dont: No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No dates, no trial timeline, no “a cure is near”.
Don't publish: GRIN Therapeutics approves first.
Don't use the 25:22–25:45 take or 13:51–13:55. Cut 13277142333 uses them.
Don't make it about the medicine, the trial or any date.
